tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe ril bsgrub tshul 'chi med dpal sbyin bzhugs/

tshe yi mchog stsol mgon po tshe dpag med/ /'chi med dpal ster rje btsun rnam par rgyal/ /tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /'chi med stsol mdzad rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'dir tshe ril bsgrub par 'dod/ / mchod pa rnams sta gon byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ bdag mdun gnyis las/ dang po la/ rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal bar gyur/ bdag mdun gyi mchod pa thun mong du byin brlab bya ba ni/ oṃ pad+ma n+ta kri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa nas haṃḥ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nas rol mo rnams dngas shing thog pa med pa zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can ster bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta ūḥhūṃ gis brlab/ de nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i buṃ pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/

slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ nas chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las sprul sku tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa sam/ bsdu na oṃ ār+ya a pā ra mi ta ā yur dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs kyis bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka'i zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar bzlas bya'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad bkugs nas sngags phreng la thim par gyur par bsams la/ gzungs ring thung gnyis ci 'grub bzlas nas mthar yig brgya brjod cing*/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya'o/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ brag zhun cong zhi/ bu ram/ mar/ ka ra/ sbrang rtsi/ shug 'bras sogs bcud len dang*/ gzhan dug rigs min pa'i sman sna tshogs dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga sogs las ril bu ci 'dod byas pa na bza' dmar po sogs gang rigs su bsgyur te bskam pa bum pa bzang po'i nang du blugs nas stegs kyi khar bzhag la/ mchod pas mtha' bskor/ rgyas par na 'dir yang byin brlab bya/ bum pa sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa dmar po mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis dkris pa'i nang du/ tshe ril rnams yongs su gyur pa las hrī/ yig dmar po re re/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ nas/ rang nyid zhes pa don te/ sngar bzhin dang*/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa re rer gyur/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas bdag la zhes pa ni 'di la zhes par bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngar ltar ro/

/de nas rab 'byams rgya mtsho'am/ mchod yon phal cher sogs kyis mchod la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ sdig pa'i dri ma phyir bsal nas/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyas par na/ nyi gzhon 'char ka mas bstod kyang mi 'gal/ de nas de rnams kyi thugs ka dang phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang du zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgrub bya'i tshe mi ma yin gyis 'phrogs pa dang brkus pa dang yar ba la sogs pa rnams bum pa dang lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang ba'i rnam par bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim yang 'od zer 'phros/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i ro bcud nus pa thams cad dang*/ skye 'phags thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin brlabs sngags dang sman la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud kyi snying po thams cad bsdus nas sngags phreng rnams la thim par gyur par bsams la/ gzungs thung la gtso bor 'bad cing*/ gzungs ring ci mang bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod cing*/ mchod bstod dang ma rnyed sogs kyis bzod gsol byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la tshe dang bsod nams ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol gdab/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs byas te/ shis brjod spyi dang*/ phyin drug dang sbyar ba'i bkra shis bya'o/ / gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gong gi yig brgya'i mjug der byin brlabs byas nas/ a kā ro 'am/ oṃ a pā ra mi tas 'bul rung*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma 'bul 'dod na'ang spyi ltar 'bul/ gzhan yang 'ga' zhig tu/ mchod gtor bla med ltar yang bya bar bshad pas/ de ltar byas kyang mi 'gal bar sems/ 'di'i skabs su thun du bcad de bsgrubs na ni phun sum tshogs par 'gyur yang*/

ma byas kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bar gang bde bya/ grol nyin par/ mchod bstod yig brgya dang bcas mjug tu/ bzod gsol dang gsol 'debs byas rjes/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrub pa ni rgyas pa'i dbang du byas la/ bsdu na bum nang gi ril bu rnams kyi steng du bla gdan la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas bcud rnams bsdus nas de nyid la thim par bsam zhing*/ sngags bzlas kyang chog par bshad do/ tshul 'dir 'bad las byung ba'i rnam dkar dges bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ko'u shri nang so yi/ /sku tshe bskal brgyar mi g.yo rtag brtan cing*/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur bsgreng gyur cig /ces tshe ril bsgrub tshul 'chi med dpal sbyin 'di yang*/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ko'u shri nang so'i sku tshe spel ba'i thabs mkhas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i phyir du bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis legs par sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/tshe ril bsgrub tshul 'chi med dpal sbyin bzhugs/ -PAGE 244--PAGE 245--PAGE 243-
